cond_0001.intro: This position is to be a member of the CNAP Material Condition Assist Team (MCAT). The function of this position is to support Habitability and Supply inspection requirements in support of contract tasking requirements.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Controls the efficient flow of goods, services, and information between point of origin through customer placement in order to meet customer requirements. Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives. Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of standard logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration and related functions. Builds relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives. Integrates learning from customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, customer service, other industries, industry groups, and professional training to continuously improve competitive position.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Must have US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor.
Must have US Navy Culinary Specialist background.
Providing essential policy and procedural guidance to oversee Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers. This includes conducting rigorous Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Must have experience acting as a Fleet Liaison, serving as a pivotal point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance. Must have the ability to obtain a CAC badge, base and ship access.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment. Must be able to lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Knowledge of US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Conducting training and technical expertise Ships Force with the purpose of enhancing shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience being a technical trainer, offering in-depth problem-solving methodologies and valuable recommendations for continuous improvements during all Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience being involved in the proper preparation of training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.
Strong communication skills, verbal, written and electronically.

The function of this position is to support Habitability and Supply inspection requirements in support of contract tasking requirements. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logistics and supply inspection work involved.
cond_0022.responsibilities: Controls the efficient flow of goods, services, and information between point of origin through customer placement in order to meet customer requirements. Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives. Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of standard logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration and related functions. Builds relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives. Integrates learning from customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, customer service, other industries, industry groups, and professional training to continuously improve competitive position.
cond_0022.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Must have US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor.
Must have US Navy Culinary Specialist background.
Providing essential policy and procedural guidance to oversee Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers. This includes conducting rigorous Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Must have experience acting as a Fleet Liaison, serving as a pivotal point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance. Must have the ability to obtain a CAC badge, base and ship access.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Knowledge of US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Conducting training and technical expertise Ships Force with the purpose of enhancing shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience being a technical trainer, offering in-depth problem-solving methodologies and valuable recommendations for continuous improvements during all Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience being involved in the proper preparation of training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.
Strong communication skills, verbal, written and electronically.
Physical Requirements
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment. Must be able to lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.

One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with Navy supply and inspection work.
cond_0131.responsibilities: Controls the efficient flow of goods, services, and information between point of origin through customer placement in order to meet customer requirements. Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives. Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of standard logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration and related functions. Builds relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives. Integrates learning from customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, customer service, other industries, industry groups, and professional training to continuously improve competitive position.
cond_0131.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Must have US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor.
Must have US Navy Culinary Specialist background.
Providing essential policy and procedural guidance to oversee Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers. This includes conducting rigorous Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Must have experience acting as a Fleet Liaison, serving as a pivotal point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance. Must have the ability to obtain a CAC badge, base and ship access.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment. Must be able to lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Knowledge of US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Conducting training and technical expertise Ships Force with the purpose of enhancing shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience being a technical trainer, offering in-depth problem-solving methodologies and valuable recommendations for continuous improvements during all Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience being involved in the proper preparation of training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.
Strong communication skills, verbal, written and electronically.

cond_0132.intro: This position is a member of the CNAP Material Condition Assist Team (MCAT). The role supports Habitability and Supply inspection requirements in line with contract tasking requirements.
cond_0132.responsibilities:
A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with customers, stakeholders, and partner organizations to keep goods, services, and information moving from point of origin through to customer placement. You will communicate daily with strategic customers and internal teams to make sure service and time objectives are met within financial constraints.
You will connect with customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, and industry groups to continuously improve competitive position. You will actively contribute to the execution and ongoing improvement of standard logistics processes, including replenishment systems, data interchange systems, demand management, and electronic data systems administration.

cond_0256.intro: This position is to be a member of the CNAP Material Condition Assist Team (MCAT). The function of this position is to support Habitability and Supply inspection requirements in support of contract tasking requirements. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logistics and supply inspection work involved.
cond_0256.responsibilities: Controls the efficient flow of goods, services, and information between point of origin through customer placement in order to meet customer requirements. Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives. Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of standard logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration and related functions. Builds relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives. Integrates learning from customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, customer service, other industries, industry groups, and professional training to continuously improve competitive position.
cond_0256.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6 Years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Must have US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor.
Must have US Navy Culinary Specialist background.
Providing essential policy and procedural guidance to oversee Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers. This includes conducting rigorous Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Must have experience acting as a Fleet Liaison, serving as a pivotal point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance. Must have the ability to obtain a CAC badge, base and ship access.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Knowledge of US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Conducting training and technical expertise Ships Force with the purpose of enhancing shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience being a technical trainer, offering in-depth problem-solving methodologies and valuable recommendations for continuous improvements during all Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience being involved in the proper preparation of training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.
Strong communication skills, verbal, written and electronically.
Physical Requirements
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment. Must be able to lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.

cond_0276.intro: This position is a member of the CNAP Material Condition Assist Team (MCAT). The role supports Habitability and Supply inspection requirements in line with contract tasking requirements.
cond_0276.responsibilities:
A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with customers, stakeholders, and partner organizations to keep goods, services, and information moving from point of origin through to customer placement. You will communicate daily with strategic customers and internal teams to make sure service and time objectives are met within financial constraints.
You will connect with customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, and industry groups to continuously improve competitive position. You will actively contribute to the execution and ongoing improvement of standard logistics processes, including replenishment systems, data interchange systems, demand management, and electronic data systems administration.
You will build and maintain relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives, regularly walking them through processes and handling questions as they arise.

6 Years relevant experience with a Bachelor's in a related field; 4 years relevant experience with a Master's in a related field; or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor.
US Navy Culinary Specialist background.
Experience providing policy and procedural guidance to oversee Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers, including conducting Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Experience as a Fleet Liaison, serving as a point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance, CAC badge, base and ship access.
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment and lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Knowledge of US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Experience conducting training and providing technical expertise to Ships Force to enhance shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience as a technical trainer, offering problem-solving methodologies and recommendations for continuous improvements during Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience preparing training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Strong computer skills with MS Office applications.
Strong communication skills, verbal, written, and electronic.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.

Ensures that customer service and time objectives are achieved within existing financial constraints in order to meet marketing and financial objectives. Ensures the execution and continuous improvement of standard logistics processes, such as the replenishment system, data interchange systems, demand management, electronic data systems administration and related functions. Builds relationships with strategic customers through logistics initiatives. Integrates learning from customers, competitors, operating entities, distribution, transportation, customer service, other industries, industry groups, and professional training to continuously improve competitive position.
cond_0588.requirements:
Around 6 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience; around 4 years of relevant experience with a Master's degree in a related field; or a High School Diploma or equivalent and around 10 years of relevant experience.
US Navy Supply background as active duty Navy and/or as a contractor is required.
US Navy Culinary Specialist background is required.
Some experience working with the COMNAVAIRPAC organization.
Familiarity with US Navy Food Service Excellence award (NEY) requirements.
Background in providing policy and procedural guidance to support Food Service operations for US Naval Carriers, including experience with Supply Management Assessments and Supply Management Inspections.
Experience conducting training and offering technical support to Ships Force to help improve shipboard Supply service operations.
Experience as a technical trainer, with exposure to problem-solving methodologies and a willingness to offer recommendations for continuous improvement during Supply assessments and inspections.
Experience acting as a Fleet Liaison or similar point of contact between US Carriers, NAVSUP, Navy Food Management Team (NFMT), and Type Commanders (TYCOM).
Some involvement in preparing training handouts for Supply Management Inspectors (SMI).
One or more assignments onboard a US Navy Aircraft Carrier.
Working knowledge of MS Office applications.
Ability to communicate effectively, verbally, in writing, and electronically.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET level security clearance. Must be able to obtain a CAC badge, base and ship access.
A current, valid DoD Secret security clearance or higher.
Physical Requirements
Must be able to work in a shipboard environment. Must be able to lift, carry, and transport heavy equipment.
